# UBIRA ETheses

> University of Birmingham's institutional thesis repository for archiving, discovering, and accessing research postgraduate theses and academic research outputs.

UBIRA ETheses is the official eData Repository for the University of Birmingham, providing a centralized platform for thesis deposit, open access publishing, and research output management. The repository supports institutional research evaluation (REF), integrates with discovery systems like FindIt@Bham and EThOS, and manages copyright and data protection compliance.

## Key Topics

- Institutional repository
- Thesis deposit and archiving
- Research postgraduate theses
- PhD theses
- Open access
- Digital archive
- Research output management
- Copyright policy
- Thesis access management
- Academic publishing
- University of Birmingham
- REF (Research Excellence Framework)
- EThOS integration
- ePrints platform
- Data protection
